claim: For users who sign in directly or through a social identity provider, the user pool free tier applies only to user pools configured to the Lite or Essentials tier; there is no free tier for the Plus tier.
question: Does the Amazon Cognito Plus tier have a free tier for users who sign in directly or through a social identity provider?

qualifiers.scope: user pool MAUs who sign in directly or through a social identity provider

evidence.quote: For users who sign in directly via Amazon Cognito or through a social identity provider, Amazon Cognito user pools has a free tier of 10,000 monthly active user (MAU) per month per account or per AWS organization. This free tier is applicable for customers that configure their user pools to either the Lite or Essentials tier. There is no free tier for the Plus tier.
